description: Spending over the last 7, 30 or 90 UTC days (today included) against the same span before, for an agentId, a wallet, a pay account or a @handle: totals and previous { payments, volume, average, payees } (previous is null when the earlier span had no payment), byDay, byAccount, byPayee (with handles), and heat, payments by weekday (row 0 Monday) and UTC hour. Volume is in dollars: USDG pay accounts paid, and Vlad gains out and standing-order runs as the contracts counted them; no price is guessed. Read from Mercatura's index, kept 2 minutes: no chain read.

ref.description: An agentId (a whole number), a wallet or a pay account (a 0x address), or a handle (@name).

name: insights
title: Insights: what an agent spent
